messages:
Ellie (Growth): thanks for the all-hands — couple quick clarifications on timelines for API / Console / Optimize. can leadership confirm which milestones are firm vs aspirational?
Maria (CEO): short version: we have hard targets for customer-facing GA windows, some internal features are flexible. details: API GA mid-May, Console 1.0 end of Q2, Optimize beta in early June.
Sara (PM): adding context — 'API GA' = public hosted API with streaming, rate limits, and basic telemetry. SDK parity (js/py) is beta but high priority.
Leo (Eng): question — does API GA include function/tool-calling or is that post-GA?
Sara (PM): function calling will be in GA for hosted customers but partner-only for Dedicated/Private initially. we'll expand after feedback.
Sam (DevEx): for the Console 1.0 scope: is rollout gated on the new telemetry pipeline? we still have the UI pieces but need the backend retention and traces.
Sara (PM): yes Console GA depends on telemetry 2.0 landing (ETL + retention). ETA for telemetry landing is June 10, which is why Console GA is end of Q2.
Leo (Eng): noted. any expected freeze dates so infra can plan capacity commits?
Maria (CEO): freeze for API GA feature set is May 1. after that it's stabilization + docs. please surface any must-haves this week.
Ellie (Growth): for Optimize beta — what beta terms? public sign-up or invite-only?
Sara (PM): invite-only to start (key customers + internal teams). feature flags will open gradually based on perf and regression checks.
roadmap-bot: <https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/all-hands-2026|Roadmap doc> updated with milestones (stamped 2026-03-23).
Sam (DevEx): action for SDK owners: update the JS SDK changelog and add streaming examples by Apr 20. I can pair if needed. :raised_hands:
Leo (Eng): action for infra: reserve additional Dedicated slots for GA ramp — I'll post the commit numbers in #eng-infra today.
Maria (CEO): two leadership asks: 1) PMs publish rollout runbooks by Apr 28, 2) Eng teams flag any capacity/legal/regulatory blockers by Apr 10.
Ellie (Growth): noted — we'll collate customer ask list and share by Apr 5.
Sara (PM): quick clarification: Optimize beta will include the recommendations UI and a limited autosuggest for batching configs, not the full auto-tuner.
Sam (DevEx): small request — can we get a canonical sample prompt set for Optimize perf tests? saves us re-producing customer prompts.
Sara (PM): yes — I'll create a sanitized prompt pack and link in the roadmap doc.
Leo (Eng): last question — are quantization recommendations in-scope for Optimize beta?
Sara (PM): not in beta. planned Q3 feature.
Ellie (Growth): thanks all — this helps. can we pin the bot doc and make these action items explicit? :thumbsup:
roadmap-bot: pinned <https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/all-hands-2026|all-hands roadmap snapshot>.
Maria (CEO): thanks everyone — appreciate the quick sync. we'll run a follow-up for open items in next leadership office hours.
